priya: Morning — quick async pipeline check.
priya: What I did: demo with NovaHealth yesterday, sent SOC2 + network overview. They asked about KMS/HSM and residency.
priya: Blockers: security wants clear KMS integration pattern (CMK vs managed) and whether Dedicated/Private can use customer HSMs. Also need an updated network diagram for procurement.
priya: Today: follow up with Maya for definitive answers, ask eng for diagram, and prep contract redlines.
sam: looping @maya — do we have a one-pager for BYOK on Dedicated/Private?
leah: there's a rough draft at /docs/enterprise/kms-weave.md but it's stale. i'll pull the key sections and paste.
maya: short answer: hosted supports AWS KMS managed keys; Dedicated supports customer-managed KMS via VPC endpoints (bring-your-own-KMS). Private/on-prem can attach an HSM connector but requires our onprem package + network config. vendor compatibility (Thales/Luna/PKCS11) needs infra confirm.
miguel: FYI on SLAs for NovaHealth — we can offer Dedicated with 99.9% p99 latency targets; I'll send a short table with observed p50/p90/p99.
priya: perfect. can someone @eng-runtime to attach the latest network diagram and call out required ports for KMS/HSM connectivity? procurement is asking specifics.
sam: on it — i'll DM eng-runtime and paste the diagram link here when i have it. also will draft a 2-line fallback note about model variant routing if capacity is constrained.
sec_bot: Audit log: import for NovaHealth (CI-4721) completed — results uploaded :white_check_mark:.
priya: thanks all. i'll stay async unless anyone needs a quick sync. :thumbsup:
